name: ATC_LIFECYCLE_STATES
description: store the lifecycle states of a lifecycle configuration

columns.name: LIFECYCLE_STATE_ID
columns.description: Unique row id for lifecycle state

columns.name: LIFECYCLE_STATE_NAME
columns.description: Indicates name of the lifecycle state

columns.name: LIFECYCLE_STATE_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Indicates description of the lifecycle state

columns.name: EDIT_FLAG
columns.description: An indicator that specifies that the project is editable in this state

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if the lifecycle state is disabled or not

columns.name: EDIT_CONTENT_FLAG
columns.description: An indicator that specifies that the entity in the project is editable in this state

columns.name: APPROVAL_FLAG
columns.description: An indicator that specifies this state needs approval to movre tro next state

columns.name: PUBLISH_FLAG
columns.description: An indicator that specifies the publish is allowed in this state

columns.name: SHARE_FLAG
columns.description: An indicator that specifies the entity can be shared  with other projects during this state

columns.name: CUSTOM_FLAG
columns.description: An indicator that specifies the state is user defined and can be altered, removed.

columns.name: STATE_SEQ
columns.description: The sequence number of the state that shows the transition

columns.name: ERROR_STATE
columns.description: Indicates the state it will end  up during transition if error happens for automatic transition like approval or publish

columns.name: USER_ACTION_NAME
columns.description: The name of the action for user triggered  state transition

columns.name: LIFECYCLE_CONFIG_ID
columns.description: lifecycle config Id with which it is associated

columns.name: AT_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the actual class type of an entity

columns.name: AT_BASE_TYPE
columns.description: Represent the base class of a given resource that has been extended

columns.name: AT_SCHEMA_LOCATION
columns.description: Indicates a url which points to a schema which allow specifying user-defined properties of an Entity or to specify the expected characteristics of an entity

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
